description: Get a secure Stripe checkout link for Yarda Pro monthly. The returned checkout shows the account's price and any eligible subscription trial (card required). This is separate from the no-card design allowance. Call only after the user explicitly asks for payment or subscription options; payment_required alone is not permission. Never call automatically when the free allowance ends, and never collect card details in chat. Give the user the secure link to open; nothing is charged until they finish checkout. Afterwards call get_account to confirm the plan is active.
